firstMismatch.source: dat/Sam-strt.lua whole program -> quest-level special loader registry -> mklev.c:load_special
firstMismatch.behavior: The Samurai quest-home transition requests special level Sam-strt. The C recorder loads its map and contents; the JavaScript registry has no Sam-strt loader and makelevel raises UnsupportedLevelChangeError at step 124.

summary: The first mismatch is the missing Samurai quest-home special-level program. `Sam-strt.lua` defines the 76-by-20 map, lighting and throne regions, branch arrival, down stair, ten doors, Lord Sato with a custom inventory, his chest, eight roshi guards, nondiggable map, six random traps, and the ordered siege monsters. `js/quest_levels.js` registers other Samurai quest levels but omits Sam-strt, so `mklev.js:load_special` cannot execute this program.

source.branch: The complete top-level Sam-strt.lua program is run when makelevel loads the Samurai quest-home special-level prototype.
callers: C mklev.c:makelevel -> load_special -> quest special-level Lua program dat/Sam-strt.lua

evidence: The accepted v65 evaluation reports 124/153 screens, 2731/3788 RNG entries, and 124/153 cursors for this case; the first unmatched input boundary is segment 0, step 124.

At js/mklev.js:691-736, makelevel calls ensureSpecialLevelLoaders and throws when slev.proto has no loader. At js/mklev.js:1947-1977, the registry combines quest-level loaders; js/quest_levels.js:3399-3403 registers Sam-loca and Sam-filb but no Sam-strt.

nethack-c/upstream/dat/Sam-strt.lua lines 17-97 contain the whole source program and ordered descriptors, including the inventory callback on Lord Sato. The corresponding special-level descriptor operations are implemented by mklev.js lspo_* handlers; lspo_monster awaits inventory callbacks after monster creation.

The task will add the complete program as a quest-level loader, generate its fixed map and descriptor tables deterministically from Sam-strt.lua, and test both generated values and delayed descriptor completion in source order.
